question: Is it acceptable to use an extension cord as permanent wiring for an appliance, run behind walls or furniture?
true_option: No — extension cords are for temporary use only, not a substitute for fixed wiring
false_option: Yes — a heavy-duty extension cord can serve as permanent wiring
true_claim_text: extension cords are temporary and cannot replace fixed wiring
false_claim_text: a heavy-duty extension cord works as permanent wiring
source: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.305(g)(1)(iv) and NFPA guidance: flexible cords may not be used as a substitute for fixed wiring; ESFI cites misused extension cords as a leading cause of home electrical fires.
